description: CREATE VIEW, SELECT from views, DROP VIEW, and catalog visibility
sql: CREATE TABLE nm_view_users (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, active BOOLEAN);
INSERT INTO nm_view_users (id, name, active) VALUES ('u1', 'Ada', true), ('u2', 'Grace', false);
CREATE VIEW nm_view_active AS SELECT id, name FROM nm_view_users WHERE active = true;
SELECT id, name FROM nm_view_active ORDER BY id;
SELECT table_name, table_type FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_name = 'nm_view_active';
SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'nm_view_active' ORDER BY ordinal_position;
